adaptations: Kept: the four entitlements with their reasons (platform-application, no-sandbox, the two storage classes roothide needs, container-required explicitly false), the /usr/bin install path and a control file without extra dependencies.

Added: the IOKit user-client list of the uikit-objc and uikit-swift templates (from platformize-app-ios) under both spellings of the key, so a tool that calls VideoToolbox, Core Video, Core Image or Metal can allocate IOSurfaces and reach the GPU.
Added: package.icon, this extension's icon on Apelin's Pages, written as the control's Icon so a package manager shows it beside the package.

Changed: platformize-bin-ios ports an upstream program; here the program itself is new, a small C tool written for Apelin with sysexits exit codes so the acceptance check can test output and exit status.

Dropped: the libroot launcher in /usr/bin that re-execs the real binary from /usr/libexec (a ported tool needs the bootstrap PATH and certificate paths; this one does not), the upstream follow/patch machinery and the Mac build scripts.
As template:c, with the program in Objective-C on Foundation.
